messages:
maya: heads-up — saw a weird delta tonight: canary routing swapped mid-stream and a subsequent tool_call ended up double-counted in provisional vs confirmed ledger :thinking:
maya: paste of the grep'd logs + small snippet below
maya: ```
2026-02-14T22:01:03Z INFO  route=canary model=redwood-v2 session=abcd resume=false
2026-02-14T22:01:05Z WARN  connection=client-74 drop->reconnect
2026-02-14T22:01:06Z INFO  route=stable  model=redwood-v2-q4 session=abcd resume=true
2026-02-14T22:01:07Z INFO  toolcall id=tc-9 prefix_tokens=32 streaming=true truncated=true
2026-02-14T22:01:07Z INFO  ledger provisional +32 tokens session=abcd origin=stream
2026-02-14T22:01:08Z INFO  ledger confirmed  +48 tokens session=abcd origin=toolcall
``` 
maya: provisional shows +32 then confirmed +48 — looks like both stream prefix and toolcall attribution applied after model swap
derek: :grimacing: do we know which component emitted the confirmed +48? router/ledger/runtime?
maya: ledger confirmed line has origin=toolcall but router logs show the packet came from the canary fallback path (route change happened just before resume)
maya: hypothesis: when route changes mid-session we end up attributing the same bytes twice because resume attaches both a cached prefix (stream origin) and then the toolcall handler also charges on truncate
sara: any repro? or is this one-off during the canary rollout?
maya: happened during a canary -> stable shift triggered by autoscaler (low capacity on canary). I can repro with a short harness (I'll paste later). Repro steps: open stream, trigger toolcall that truncates, simulate canary OOM -> router moves request to stable and issues a resume
tom: hmm — similar to earlier race but with a model swap in the middle. We already dedupe retries by session id, but the resume + toolcall truncation path is messy
derek: quick thought: we should add an explicit token-origin tag on resume RPCs (e.g. X-Inflight-Token-Origin: stream|toolcall) so ledger can ignore duplicates when both origins are reported within a short window
sara: that'll require plumbing from runtime -> router -> ledger. Is there an easier short-term guard? maybe require toolcall handler to check if prefix was already credited this session id and skip if so
maya: toolcall handler already tries to avoid double-charging using recent-prefix-cache but that cache is keyed by (route, session, prefix-hash). route switched so key missed
tom: could instead key by session+prefix-hash only (ignore route) and set TTL small (30s). That would avoid route races but means a benign case where same prefix legitimately reruns on another route may be skipped
derek: agree TTL tradeoff is ok if we document it — typical session lifetimes are short for streams; plus confirmed ledger will still eventually reconcile but we want to avoid provisional double-counts
sara: UX/console implication: provisional vs confirmed mismatch will cause spikes in per-route charts. We should add an annotation when route change occurs mid-session so ops can filter those spurious diffs
maya: proposed immediate steps:
1) short-term: change prefix-cache key to (session, prefix-hash) TTL=30s in toolcall-charge path (patch ready, small change) — prevents double-charge across route swaps
2) medium-term: add X-Inflight-Token-Origin on resume + require ledger to de-dupe near-simultaneous origins
3) dashboard: add route-change annotation on session timeline and a provisional/confirmed diff flag
maya: patch snippet for (1):
```go
// before: cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s", route, sessionID, prefixHash)
// after:
cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s", sessionID, prefixHash) // drop route
cache.Set(cacheKey, true, 30*time.Second)
```
maya: canary patch targets: runtime toolcall-charge, router resume path (no changes), ledger (none)
derek: good. do we need a migration/rollback plan? if we roll this out and someone relies on route-scoped cache semantics we might undercharge a tiny fraction
tom: risk low. we can ship behind runtime flag and enable for 24h on canary then flip cluster-wide
sara: I'll make the dashboard annotation ticket. can we add a small counter: route-swap-double-charge-detected to help monitor after change?
maya: yep will emit a metric when we detect both stream origin and toolcall charge within 5s for same session+prefix
derek: approve for canary behind flag. assign owners?
maya: I'll own runtime patch + metric (maya)
derek: I'll own rollout flag + monitor alert (derek)
sara: I'll own dashboard annotation + ticket (sara)
tom: I'll review the patch and the ledger de-dupe design for medium-term (tom)
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: canary rollout -> 1h monitor -> evaluation -> staged cluster roll
maya: thanks all. i'll open the PR and add the harness + logs. cc @tom for patch review.
